newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shandong Xinhua offers 140 mln H-shares at HK$1.82.
newsitem.headline: Shandong Xinhua offers 140 mln H-shares at HK$1.82.

text.p: Shandong Xinhua Pharmaceutical Co Ltd said on Monday it is offering 140 million H-shares at HK$1.82 per share with an overallotment option for up to another 10 million H-share at the same price.

The share offer, which represents 34.4 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, will run from December 17 to December 20, the company said in a statement. Dealing in the shares is expected to start on December 31.
Nomura International (Hong Kong) Ltd is the global coordinator and lead manager of the issue.
Shandong Xinhua said its turnover reached 712 million yuan for the year ended December 31, 1995, but it did not give an earnings figure for the year.
The company forecast net profit of about 90 million yuan for the year ending December 31, 1996.

Shandong Xinhua, the last H-share expected to be listed this year, engages in the development, manufacture and sales of bulk pharmaceutical, preparation and chemical products. H-shares are Hong Kong-listed shares of China-incorporated enterprises.

The issue will raise about 245.8 million yuan after expenses. Of the proceeds, about 135 million yuan will be used to finance upgrading of production technology in the company's existing factory and about 60 million yuan will be for building new assembly lines for newly developed products.
The balance will be used to repay bank loans and as working capital. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
